task: put the bowl on the plate

windows.text: Reach the empty gripper over the table toward the metal bowl beside the bottle.
Approach the metal bowl from above, bringing the open gripper down over its center.
Approach the metal bowl from above, bringing the open gripper down over its center.
Grasp the metal bowl between the fingers while it rests on the table.
Lift the metal bowl up off the table, away from the plate.
Carry the bowl over the table toward the plate.
Lower the bowl down onto the plate.
Release the bowl onto the plate and open the gripper.
